_comment: AutoGPT (Classic) built-in command surface (agpt.co classic forge docs). read_website + search_web bring untrusted content; read_file reads private files; write_file is a local write; execute_python_code / execute_shell run arbitrary code — the external-comms leg (documented RCE surface, positive.security/blog/auto-gpt-rce).
